dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High prominence; sharp, linear pale boundaries on the outer webs of primary and secondary feathers against dark centers

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Broad area of high-contrast white/buff scalloping appearing as concentric arcs on the posterior neck
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Distinct linear boundary where the uniform brown crown meets the onset of heavy pale-edged scaling on the nape

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced scalloped texture on the neck and upper back caused by extreme contrast between dark feather centers and wide pale-buff fringes
